# HomeMaid Q3'26: Rekordmarginal och Företagsstäd vänder uppåt

**Feed**: inderes-se  
**Published**: 2026-11-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is an Inderes TV interview with HomeMaid CEO Stefan Högqvist about the Q3'26 report. Home cleaning (Hemstäd) had its best margin ever and grew 17%, partly through acquisitions. Business cleaning (Företagsstäd) is recovering after a weak Q2 under a corrective programme. The company is buying 80% of Mamasin, which has 52 MSEK in sales and a 14% EBITA margin. The tone is upbeat: September set a record for subscription sales, debt is low at about 1.1x net debt/EBITDA, the high dividend continues alongside acquisitions, and tighter ROT/RUT control rules are seen as a tailwind for serious operators.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 HOME-B — HomeMaid | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Record Hemstäd margin, faster growth, record subscription sales, Företagsstäd turnaround under way, accretive Mamasin deal, low debt and high dividend.

#### Reasoning

This is a management interview, not an independent analyst call. The CEO describes rising gross margin even while buying lower-margin companies. Growth is roughly in line with or above a RUT market growing ~11%, and 80% of revenue is subscriptions. The Mamasin deal (14% EBITA, guided to ~10%) should lift business-cleaning margins. The balance sheet leaves room for both dividends and M&A. The view is positive but rests on the company's own statements, so it is a watch for the Företagsstäd turnaro

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Företagsstäd turnaround stalls or margin problems spread to other subsidiaries
- if Hemstäd gross margin falls back
- if subscription sales or growth slow
- if Mamasin margin drops well below the ~10% guidance

> *"Så jag hade hållit koll på tillväxten."*
